Life is full of small surprises. David is reading a book about English. David and Sam had great fun there. The movers carried the piano up the narrow stairs.

There are always many people at the playground. Both of them like bread and water. David thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, the coffee stain on my white shirt will not come out.
Last Thursday, David and Sam went to the classroom. The weather was snowy that day. David drinks water after doing sports. Reading builds knowledge day by day.
David wrote about the day in the diary. David hopes to visit Rome one day. David plays table tennis with Sam every Thursday.
